relations: A moving specular flare on the gem's top edge shifts internal blue and violet facet bands in intensity.
The inverted reflection on the glossy black surface brightens and dims in tandem with the gemstone's internal shimmering.
Tiny background light specks flicker subtly while the gemstone's overall silhouette and position remain fixed.
caption: The video showcases a single large faceted transparent gemstone, cut in a pear or marquise shape, resting on a glossy black mirror surface that casts a crisp inverted reflection beneath it against a pure black backdrop scattered with tiny light specks. The stone's silhouette, orientation, and position remain essentially fixed, so the main visible motion is light playing across its surface. A bright starburst specular flare travels along the top edge of the gem, starting at the upper-right tip and gradually relocating to the upper-center-left ridge. There it swells into a taller, brighter vertical streak. As this highlight moves, the colored facet bands inside the crystal vary through blues, violets, and whites, changing in intensity. These shimmering internal reflections are mirrored in the inverted image below, which brightens and dims in tandem. A handful of small white points in the dark background flicker and vary subtly in brightness.
